🧮 Job Requisition Form Settings
  • The external Job Requisition form renders from the Job Requisition DocType automatically — same fields, tabs, sections and mandatory rules.
  • Add a row below only for a field you want to change: hide it, force mandatory/optional, relabel, regroup, or restrict child-table columns.
  • No row for a field = it follows the doctype exactly.
  • Turn on Show Only Configured Fields to render ONLY the fields you list below (strict allowlist) instead of the whole doctype.
  • Turn on Configure Basis Hiring Type to give every field a Hiring Type (Both / Fresher / Lateral). The form then asks for Hiring Type first and renders only that type's fields. Leave it off and every field renders for all requisitions, as before.

fields.label: Show Only Configured Fields
fields.description: Off (default) = render the full Job Requisition form, minus any field you mark Hide. On = render ONLY the fields listed below.

fields.label: Configure Basis Hiring Type
fields.description: Off (default) = every configured field renders for all requisitions, exactly as before. On = each field in the builder gets a Hiring Type (Both / Fresher / Lateral, default Lateral) and the external form renders only the fields matching the Hiring Type the user picks.
